# phron_storage_bucket_limit (Resource)

The optional size limit of an existing bucket, a spend guard. Destroying the resource removes the limit. Do not set limit_bytes on the phron_storage_bucket as well.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "phron_storage_bucket_limit" "logs" {
  bucket_name = phron_storage_bucket.logs.full_name
  limit_bytes = 1000000000000
  location    = "fsn1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) The bucket's full name (phron_storage_bucket.full_name).
- `limit_bytes` (Number) The size limit in bytes.

### Optional

- `location` (String) The Location id of the storage, when the Workspace has storage in more than one.
- `workspace_id` (String) The Workspace of the bucket. Empty means the Organization's default Workspace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The bucket's full name.
- `phase` (String) How far the limit has reached the storage servers: applying, applied, not_converged or not_verifiable.
